observations.why: First-person plural 'we' enacts communal-sharing — the team as one body adopting a shared decision.
Proportionality framing — performance gain quantified as a cost/benefit ratio against the current setup.
Commissive act binds the collective to a shared timeline; 'the migration' presupposes a communal undertaking already decided.
Decision-record format enacts authority-ranking — a labeled allocation pronouncing the chosen technology from a position of decisional authority.
Proportionality restated in the decision record — performance gain quantified as ROI justification.
